plan.scene: Top-down view of a vintage red-patterned rug beside a cream sofa on a wooden floor, warm sunlight streaks across the floor, a dark wooden ceiling fan spins between the camera and the floor.

shots.what: the woman lies on her back on the rug holding a TV remote, wearing a black hoodie and baggy dark jeans; a fan blade sweeps across the lens
after the wipe the woman lies in the same pose wearing a camouflage jacket and camouflage shorts
after the next wipe the woman lies there wearing a red varsity jacket with cream sleeves and white trousers

subjects.role: the person lying on the rug
subjects.traits: a young woman with long straight black hair and blunt bangs

constraints: Her outfit changes at each ceiling fan wipe exactly as the shots describe.
